Native-safe adaptations summary (documented in-file header): react-i18next, @/components/ui Input/Select/Button, lucide-react, @/lib/cn Tailwind classes/CSS vars, and the @/lib + @/types + ../components aliases are all replaced by RN primitives (View/Pressable/Modal/ScrollView/TextInput) + the shared native AppText/GlassPanel/SemanticIcon/HelpTooltip + theme tokens. The web `<select>` inline dropdown becomes a centered Modal listbox (Combobox/HelpTooltip popover idiom); fixed Tailwind w-NN widths become responsive flex so rows wrap on phones. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported. Every exported symbol (CONDITION_TYPES, createDefaultCondition, ConditionBuilder, AutomationConditionStepInput) keeps its web name. Verified with cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles, and a new __tests__/ConditionBuilderParity.test.tsx (10 cases covering the factory, all four kinds, add/remove, kind/signal/operator/timezone selects, numeric coercion, and the day-pill toggle math).
